name: reuse-notion-projects
query: Set up the Q1 pricing page launch as a project. Target date March 3.

context.conversation: Workstreams: design, web, marketing. Owners not decided.

success_criteria: Setup card offers 'Add to Projects' first (Recommended) and 'Keep it separate', naming the actual databases.
On 'Add to Projects': creates one project row and related tasks in the existing Tasks database using its own field names (Assignee, Due) and status options; creates no new database.
The project page shows a tasks view filtered by the Project relation that excludes 'Audit top 20 articles'.
Does not explain databases and views as if the user were new (they already use them); unknown owners stay empty.
Leaves the existing project and task untouched.
